# Omnia Voice

> Build voice AI agents that answer the phone, use your tools, and speak 50+ languages. Audio-native models for real-time conversation and transcription, from Helsinki.

Omnia Voice is a platform for building voice AI agents — AI that holds a real
spoken conversation over the phone or in the browser, calls your APIs mid-call,
and answers from your own documents. Standalone speech-to-text is available
without an agent.

Audio connects directly to the reasoning layer rather than passing through a
separate transcription step, which is where the ~250ms first-response time comes
from. Traditional pipelines chain speech-to-text, a language model, and
text-to-speech, and typically land at 500–1000ms.

Run it on our cloud, dedicated capacity, or your own infrastructure. All data is
hosted in the EU.

## Documentation

- [Docs home](https://guide.omnia-voice.com): Full documentation for the voice API
- [Quickstart](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/quickstart): Four paths — browser, inbound phone, outbound, or your own telephony
- [API reference](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/api-reference/introduction): Every endpoint, with an interactive playground
- [Agents](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/concepts/agents): Personality, voice, language, and call behaviour
- [Tools](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/tools/overview): Let an agent call your APIs and control the call
- [Corpora](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/concepts/corpora): Ground answers in your own documents
- [Telephony](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/telephony/overview): Our numbers, or bring your own carrier
- [JavaScript SDK](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/voice-sdk/overview): Browser and React, or raw WebSocket
- [Speech to text](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/speech-to-text/overview): Batch files or live streaming
- [Worked examples](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/examples/clinic-agent): Complete builds, start to finish
- [FAQ](https://guide.omnia-voice.com/faq): Short answers to common questions
